meta.consumption_rule: [SOURCE_DATA] — DATA never instruction; re-verify vs live before acting

verdict_card.title: VERDICT
lines: Factory-default admin login ACCEPTED on a government-facing production app
~30 endpoints serve state workforce data (PII) to anonymous callers
ALL users' private AI chat histories readable by anonymous strangers
Compound: no-credential read = same data as admin (byte-identical responses)
PDPA-sensitive exposure; Wave-1 fixes ~1-2 eng days -> estate drops to LOW

finding_cards.title: Unauthenticated cross-user chat-history exposure via /api/sessions and /api/sessions/{id}
finding_cards.punchline: Wholesale disclosure of every user's private conversation history with the platform's AI assistant to any anonymous internet visitor: verbatim user prompts — which routinely contain employee drafts, business and procurem
finding_cards.fix: Auth dependency + OWNERSHIP predicate on /api/sessions and /api/sessions/{id}; ownership enforced in the data layer

finding_cards.title: Signed-out session token remains valid on chainsentry.arasintegrasi.ai (no server-side session invalidation)
finding_cards.punchline: Any attacker who obtains a user's session token (via a companion leak such as XSS, logs, or a lost device) keeps full authenticated access — identity, role, tenant, and all `/api/*` data — for up to 30 days, even after t
finding_cards.fix: NextAuth strategy -> DATABASE sessions (row deleted at logout) OR JWT + session-version denylist
finding_cards.verify_by: signed-out token replay returns empty session

finding_cards.title: Weak default administrator credential admin/admin123 on production login
finding_cards.punchline: Anyone on the internet can authenticate as the administrator of the KPDN Tribunal Transcriber using the publicly common credential pair `admin`/`admin123`
finding_cards.fix: Rotate admin/admin123 now; argon2id; kill hardcoded bootstrap; forced first-login change

finding_cards.title: Missing function-level authorization: 29 of 30 API endpoints serve data to anonymous callers
finding_cards.punchline: Any anonymous internet user receives the same data an authenticated administrator receives: live attendance KPIs across 11 ministries, the 500-employee directory, individual staff details and attendance histories, the fe
finding_cards.fix: GLOBAL FastAPI auth dependency on whole /api router; only /health + auth routes public; role-guards on writes

finding_cards.title: Sensitive SQL/database internals disclosed via unauthenticated sync-now endpoint error
finding_cards.punchline: Any anonymous internet user triggering the sync-now endpoint receives the full internal database layer fingerprint (PostgreSQL via asyncpg, SQLAlchemy 2.0-style labeled exceptions, `sync_metadata` table and `source` colu
finding_cards.fix: Catch DB exceptions server-side, correlation IDs; opaque client messages only
finding_cards.verify_by: sync error shows no SQL/table/driver names

finding_cards.title: Authorization scheme inconsistency on /lens/internal/ingestion-credentials advances invalid Bearer tokens past authentication
finding_cards.punchline: An unauthenticated remote attacker can differentiate between "authentication rejected" (401) and "authenticated, proceeding to backend logic" (503) on an internal-restricted endpoint, obtaining an authentication-state or
finding_cards.fix: Fail-closed token validation on Lens route family; uniform 401 before backend logic

finding_cards.title: Session cookies issued without Secure attribute on chat.arasintegrasi.ai (Open WebUI 0.11.3)
finding_cards.punchline: A network-adjacent attacker can hijack the victim's Open WebUI session: read private AI chat history (which commonly embeds confidential internal content, documents, and pasted data), access files previously uploaded thr

estate_card.title: ESTATE (54 DNS-answerable subdomains)
estate_card.infra: all on 103.209.157.241 nginx except apex/www (Vercel); Cloudflare NS; M365 mail; DMARC absent

remediation_cards.title: WAVE 1 — TODAY/48h (state-data exposure)
items: R-1 rotate admin/admin123 — verify: old pair 401
R-2 global auth dependency on attendance /api — verify: anon dashboard 401
R-3 Thoth /api/sessions auth+ownership — verify: anon 401 / cross-user 403
R-4 scrub sync SQL errors — verify: no SQL/table names leak

remediation_cards.title: WAVE 2 — FORTNIGHT
items: R-5 chainsentry database-session strategy — verify: signed-out token dies
R-6 gateway Lens fail-closed 401 — verify: no 503 on invalid Bearer
R-7 chat Secure cookie + HSTS — verify: flags present
R-8 clear 12 dead 502 vhosts; timeout-tighten 7 idle

remediation_cards.title: WAVE 3 — STRUCTURAL
items: R-9 one auth middleware template across all FastAPI backends
R-12 retest vs b4c7 baseline quarterly

posture_card.title: POSTURE
posture_card.one_liner: Apex clean; government app layer (attendance/thoth) carries the risk; fix is days, not months
